P1.1.text: A benefits experience your employees will love. The efficiency your business needs. | Alight

P1.2.text: Alight works with the best-known brands to create a benefits advantage -- an opportunity to optimize costs while delivering a world-class benefits experience.

P1.3.text: Turning benefits complexity into better outcomes at scale.

P1.4.text: Alight is the only company of our size and scale with singular focus on benefits administration and every dollar we invest strengthens this mission

P1.5.text: Deliver a singular, personalized benefits experience for every employee

P1.6.text: Unify your benefits ecosystem with the Alight Worklife ® platform

P1.7.text: Integrate more than 600 tools from your HR and benefits ecosystem easily and at your own pace with the open architecture and industrial-strength security capabilities of the Alight Worklife platform.

P1.8.text: Do more with AI that listens, learns and adapts

P1.9.text: Personalize the employee benefits experience and automate critical tasks with Alight LumenAI — the powerful AI engine behind Alight Worklife. Fueled by comprehensive employee data with advanced analytics, you get deeper insights for better decisions.

P1.10.text: Boost engagement with better benefits support

P1.11.text: With health and medical allies, absence administrators, financial advisors and guidance counselors, your employees get answers to their toughest questions and your team is freed to focus on strategic priorities.

P1.12.text: Make the shift to a new model of benefits management

P1.13.text: Let Alight untangle the benefits sprawl.

P1.16.text: Gain a true benefits advantage with Alight Worklife solutions

P1.17.text: Trusted by the world's best companies.

P1.18.text: We partner with a majority of the Fortune 100 and a significant number of Fortune 500 companies to transform the way they work.

P1.20.text: Gartner C-level Communities | Chicago CHRO Community Executive Summit

P1.22.text: Alight & Sword Health's Partner Reception at HR Tech 2026

P1.24.text: Case Study: Siemens Energy & Alight Healthcare Navigation

P1.25.text: Alight's Benefits Operating System combines 30 million users, decades of domain expertise, and AI-powered guidance into a single, unified platform that turns complexity into outcomes.

P1.27.text: The 2025 Employee Mindset Study marks Alight’s 15th annual report focused on the U.S. workforce, delving into key areas such as employee wellbeing, workplace culture, benefits engagement, total rewards and technology.

P1.29.text: Our team is here to help.

P2.2.text: We're proud to be recognized as a leader and an innovator in this space.

P2.3.text: Through the administration of employee benefits, Alight helps clients gain a benefits advantage while building a healthy and financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, absence management and navigation.

P2.4.text: Our Alight Worklife ® platform empowers employers to gain a deeper understanding of their workforce and engage them throughout life’s most important moments with personalized benefits management and data-driven insights, leading to increased employee wellbeing, engagement and productivity.

P2.5.text: Move with purpose. Learn fast. Adapt quickly.

P2.6.text: Lead by example. Own the outcome. Serve others.

P2.7.text: Do the right thing — even when it is difficult or unseen.

P2.8.text: Stay curious. Keep learning. Never stop improving.

P2.9.text: Do it thoughtfully. Do it completely. Do it well.

P2.10.text: Trust is earned through consistency, authenticity and credibility.

P2.11.text: Connect your full spectrum of benefits, from pre-hire to retire and beyond.

P2.12.text: Get AI-driven personalization, automation and insights for better decisions.

P2.13.text: Streamlined processes for both you and your employees.

P2.14.text: Built for the world’s best companies

P2.15.text: Leverage modern, composable architecture for category leaders with scale and complexity.

P2.17.text: Alight introduces GLP-1 HRA solution to help employers manage access, affordability and cost

P2.18.text: Better wellbeing, bigger worries: Alight research finds financial stress and healthcare complexity continue to challenge employees

P1.1.text: Unify HR, Finance, & IT | HR & Payroll Simplified | Paylocity

P1.2.text: Paylocity unifies HR, Finance, and IT on one HCM platform, so you can stop piecing systems together and start moving forward together.

P1.3.text: The next evolution of work is here to automate manual processes, reduce risk, and help you move faster.

P1.5.text: Power every team with a single software

P1.6.text: Our flexible solutions drive innovation, enable smarter decisions, transform workforces, fuel growth, and inspire confident leadership.

P1.7.text: Simplify payroll and filing taxes with an intuitive, modern platform and expert support, knowing your payroll is accurate each time.

P1.8.text: Transform spend management – real-time visibility, AI-powered automation, seamless integration, smarter workflows.

P1.9.text: Centralize asset management, access control, and service support – empowering IT to enable the business, not just support it.

P1.10.text: A Payroll bundle is any new purchase of Payroll, standalone or bundled with other products.

P1.11.text: “It was everything we needed, all in one place. Paylocity’s solution helped modernize the entire employee experience.”

P1.12.text: “Paylocity helps us automate manual tasks, save time, and improve our decision-making with data and reporting.”

P1.13.text: What connects it all sets us apart

P1.14.text: Stay informed, engaged, and productive with one mobile experience.

P1.15.text: Automation and insight embedded in daily processes make everyone more efficient.

P1.16.text: Seamless connections across all your tools that unify data and user experience.

P1.17.text: Real-time dashboards and guided actions turn data into decisions.

P1.18.text: Automated processes from end to end save time and improve accuracy.

P1.19.text: Dedicated partnership and support you can count on.

P1.20.text: The ultimate platform for today's workforce

P1.21.text: Paylocity brings HR, Finance, and IT together to empower teams, simplify processes, and deliver real results. But we're more than a platform — we're the partner helping you shape the future of work.

P1.22.text: We stand by your side to help you hit your goals. Our ideas are grounded in your real needs — not in guesswork.

P1.23.text: Innovation is at the heart of what we do.

P1.24.text: Clients say we deliver the best service, and we strive to keep every interaction clear, helpful, and human.

P1.26.text: Dive into the latest research from industry leaders, and get the practical insights you need to automate smarter, act on real data, and make better workforce decisions.

P1.27.text: Bring HR and Finance together to streamline operations and control company-wide expenses in one place.

P1.28.text: The next evolution of work is here.

P1.29.text: Connect. Learn. Get more from Paylocity. Join us November 4-5

P1.30.text: Import your W-2 directly from Paylocity to one of three tax preparers at no cost and get a head start on your refund.

P2.2.text: From the just-starting-out local boutique to the rapidly growing franchises, from brokerage firms to associations, we tailor solutions for today and the future.

P2.3.text: Built for teams who value connection and efficiency

P2.4.text: Executives and business owners steer the ship. You need a solution that keeps productivity up and turnover down.

P2.5.text: HR leaders are the champions of a thriving workforce, creating a culture for everyone. You need a platform that matches your passion for nurturing talent.

P2.6.text: Employees expect the right pay, every time, and payroll admins are there to get it right every time. You need tools to simplify the process and lighten your load.

P2.7.text: IT is the guardian of a company's infrastructure. You depend on systems that keep technology functioning smoothly, protect data, and scale for growth.

P2.8.text: Employees are at the heart of any business. You need simple, but impactful solution to stay connected to your coworkers and culture.

P2.9.text: For brokers, advisors, consultants, and advocates by any other name, relationships are everything. The right platform helps you deepen client relationships and grow your book
